_about: What each player actually runs on the platform. deploy/paste-ready.md and the dashboard's Current Deployment card are generated from this. 'prompt': 'current' means prompts/<slot>/current.md; any other value is an explicit file (an override). Update this file whenever what's deployed differs from current.md, and remove an override when a release replaces it. DEF on Nova Micro from v12 is a one-match speed test (match 020 action item); switch back to Claude Haiku here if his play degrades.
